question_wording: Dvs, cu cine veți vota în turul 2 al alegerilor prezidențiale ?
notes: Three bases: total sample (p. 3), expressed votes (p. 4), and expressed votes of respondents who say they will vote (p. 5, other_subset). Crosstabs by round-1 vote (pp. 6-8) are not recorded. The report names no client and no population beyond 'reprezentativ pe variabilele socio-demografice'. HotNews (https://hotnews.ro/live-video-sondajul-prezentat-de-nicusor-dan-la-trei-zile-dupa-primul-tur-al-alegerilor-prezidentiale-1967952) reports that candidate Nicușor Dan commissioned the poll and presented it on 2025-05-07, and gives the margin of error as +/-3%; the report's 3.19 is used (pollster's report wins).
